title: PAR-134 MLEADER annotation-context CMC RGB and block-content DWG output
scope: Retain the embedded text, background-fill, and block-content CMC RGB values
Encode the ODA-defined text and block branches of the embedded annotation context
Verify exact CMC positions, block transform alignment, and handle roles with generated controls

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: §20.4.86 places CMC fields for text color, background fill color, and block color in conditional context branches. The block branch contains three 3BD vectors, rotation, CMC color, then 16 transformation doubles; its AcDbBlockTableRecord handle is a soft pointer. §2.11 defines the R2004+ CMC reserved BS, method-packed BL, and RC optional-name flags.

localSource.finding: The parser previously retained only scalar context colors, and the DWG context encoder rejected block content. The model now retains RGB companions; the encoder emits the text and block alternatives, including the block transform, and writes the block-table record reference as a soft pointer. The parser now rejects a block-context reference with a non-soft-pointer handle code.
localSource.compatibility: Three appended DRW_MLeaderAnnotContext members change the public context and containing MLEADER class sizes; downstream consumers must rebuild. No virtual method or DRW_Interface callback changed.

generatedControls.finding: Text, background, and block color positions cover C0 ByLayer, C1 ByBlock, C3 ACI, and C2 RGB (including RGB zero). Independent wire walks verify CMC ordering and the block transform boundary; parser checks verify colors, text/style or block/soft-pointer handles, transform values, and following-handle alignment. Negative controls cover out-of-range RGB, scalar/RGB mismatch, invalid absent sentinel, inactive-branch RGB, and simultaneous DWG text/block branch flags. Copy, assignment, and reset controls cover the new companions.
generatedControls.limit: Locally generated vectors are not producer-authored samples. This slice does not qualify native block rendering, DXF flag legality or truecolor mapping, optional CMC names/books, standalone context-data objects, or arbitrary MLEADER semantics.

productionSummary: Append textColorRgb, bgFillColorRgb, and blockColorRgb with -1 absent sentinels.
Capture C2 RGB during bounded annotation-context text, background-fill, and block-color reads.
Emit C2 when RGB is present while retaining C0/C1/C3 indexed output.
Encode the ODA conditional text or block context branch, including the 16-value block transform.
Write and require the block-table-record context reference as a soft pointer.
Refuse invalid CMC state, RGB in inactive branches, and simultaneous DWG context branches before output.

unresolved: DXF truecolor and optional CMC color/book name semantics remain unaudited for these context fields.
The separate DXF inactive-branch payload/loss guard remains open under PAR-20; DWG branch constraints do not define DXF legality.
Standalone context-data object serialization and complete owner-graph replay remain separate work.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
